about: [C8] proof (WAVE_C §7) for VIII The Block: the player who does nothing loses every contest, the warning up a second and more before, the reason said. The nick of time at the kerb (Sal's clock: 'Last time, sister.', then Too late.), each movement of the street (cars, flank, el), each stage of the Cardinal (the saloon, him, the last ten seconds). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/block_idle.json (drivers: tools/lib/c8_nick.mjs, tools/lib/c8_block.mjs)

steps.label: the nick of time, hands off: warned ('He's going to shoot her!'), then Too late.
every movement and every stage of him, hands off: lost, each warned a second and more, each with its reason
